bhajans.title: Govinda Krishna Vithale
bhajans.lyrics:
Govinda Krishna Vittala Venu Gopala Krishna Vittala
Panduranga Vittala Jaya Pandari Natha Vittala
Govinda Vittala Gopala Vittala
Panduranga Vittala Pandari Natha Vittala
Vittala Vittala Panduranga (4)

bhajans.title: Sri Rama Jaya Rama Jaya Jaya Rama
bhajans.lyrics:
Sri Rama Jaya Rama Jaya Jaya Rama
Sri Rama Jaya Rama Sundara Nama

bhajans.title: Sri Ram Jaya Ram Jaya Jaya Ram Janaki Jeevana Ram
Prashanti Nilaya Ram Hey Parthipuri Bhagavan
Guru Deva Guru Deva Guruvayurpura Hari Deva
Guru Brahma Guru Vishnu Guru Deva Maheshwara
Jaya Guru Jaya Guru Sai Ram
Jaya Maa Jaya Maa Jaya Shiridi Shankari Maa
Satya Guru Dev Raah Dikhao Prabhu
Krishna Krishna Mujhe Darshan Do Krishna
Sai Shankara Sathya Sai Shankara Narayana Bhagavan
Shiva Shiva Shiva Shiva Shambho Shiva
Janani Janani Maa Shankari Durgati Nasini Maa
Sairam Ghana Shyam Bhagavan Tumhara Naam
Rama Sumira Mana Rama Sumira Mana
Jai Sai Ram Jai Sai Ram
Hare Krishna Hare Ram Sai Ram Sai Ram
Sainatha Deena Natha Brahma Roopa Sadguru
Hey Deena Dayalu Hare Hare Sai Ram Hare Hare
Shiradi Sai Shankara Parthi Vihari Shankara
Om Namashivaya Om Namashivaya Om Namashivaya Nama Om Nama Om
Krishna Rama Govinda Gokula Nandana Gopala
Sri Guru Jaya Guru Sainatha Sadguru
Aao Sai Gopal Aao Gopal Aao Gopal
Sundara Sundara Nache Sundara Sai Ghana Shyam
Sai Tere Charano Mey Koti Pranam
Sri Rama Rama Rama Yadunandana Rama Ram
Ayodhya Vihari Sri Rama Rama Rama
Shiva Shiva Shiva Shiva Shambho Shiva
Dasaratha Nandana Rama Daya Sagara Rama
Gopi Ramana Gopala Gopala Sai Gopala
Dayasudha Barsao Mata Jaya Jaya Jaya Ambe
Hey Parthipureesa Prashanti Vasa Sadguru Sairam
Harey Ram Harey Ram Harey Rama Krishna Harey Ram
Hari Om Hari Om Hari Om Narayana
Dhim Dhim Dhimi Dhimi Natana Shiva
Sathya Dharma Shanti Prema Swaroopa Prashanti Nilaya
Prema Mayi Sai Ma Gnanamayi Sai Ma
Bhajo Sita Ram Bhajo Radhe Shyam
Deva Deva Sai Mahadeva Sai Shankara
Shirdi Mera Pandharpur Hai Parthi Mera Kashi
Jaya Ram Hare Jaya Ram Hare
Radhe Shyama Murari Jai Govinda Gopal
Tum Ho Ram Tum Ho Shyam
Sao Hai Jeevan Jeevan Sathya Sai
Jai Sai Ram Jai Sai Ram
Mukunda Madhava Karivarada Sri Sathya Sai Ram
Kanha Kanhaiya Bansi
